review_candidates.title: Technisch projectmanager
review_candidates.description: Hou je van een open cultuur, korte lijnen en een no-nonsense mentaliteit? Dan ben jij misschien wel dé collega, die we zoeken om ons dynamisch team te versterken. SEA-Tank Terminal, is een sterk groeiend tankopslagbedrijf in een internationale omgeving en is o.a. actief in de haven van Gent & Antwerpen. Wij zijn gespecialiseerd in de opslag van liquide goederen en logistieke afhandeling voor derden. Voor een nieuw strategisch project in Avonmouth, in samenwerking met onze partner, zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren Technisch Project Manager . Het project omvat de ombouw van een LNG-installatie (Liquefied Natural Gas) naar LPG (propaan), inclusief de opzet van het toekomstig operationeel beheer van het tankpark. Het betreft een meerjarig traject (± 2 jaar) met aansluitend ondersteuning van het lokale operationele team om een vlotte en duurzame overdracht te garanderen. Jouw functie Als Technisch Project Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de overkoepelende opvolging en bewaking van het project. Je fungeert als senior sparringpartner voor het lokale projectteam en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie van SEA-Tank. Takenpakket: Je bewaakt de globale voortgang, planning, budget en mijlpalen; Je zorgt voor een sterke sense of urgency binnen het project; Je daagt het lokale team uit op kwaliteit, efficiëntie en respecteren van deadlines; Je werkt nauw samen met de lokale projectmanager; Je rapporteert periodiek aan de directie over voortgang, risico’s en beslissingspunten Je begeleidt het project van detailed engineering, over de bouwfase, tot oplevering en de eerste weken van operaties; Na oplevering ondersteun je het lokale operationele team om een vlotte transitie te verzekeren. Je focus zal dus niet liggen op de dagelijkse operationele aansturing. Je werkt vanuit Avonmouth, met sporadische verplaatsingen naar het projectteam in Antwerpen en het studiebureau in Spanje. Jouw profiel Opleiding & achtergrond Master in Ingenieurswetenschappen (Bouwkunde, Proces-chemie of Elektromechanica); Technische en projectervaring Gedegen ervaring in technische projectomgevingen binnen Europa. Ervaring in het Verenigd Koninkrijk is een sterke troef. Ervaring met liquide bulk en/of gassen (LPG, LNG …); Ervaring in tankterminals en tankbouw of tankomvorming; Ervaring met: Marine infrastructuur zoals marine loading arms; Ondergrondse of geboorde pijpleidingen; Truck loading stations; Aantoonbare end-to-end projectervaring: van detailed engineering tot commissioning en opstart; Ervaring in samenwerking met EPC-contractoren (Engineering, Procurement & Construction); Kennis van of ervaring met COMAH/SEVESO-regelgeving. Persoonlijke kwaliteiten Vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels; Productie- en resultaatgedreven; Actiegericht, besluitvaardig en hands-on ingesteld; Sterk in stakeholdermanagement en communicatie; Kan teams challengen op een constructieve manier; Gedijt goed in een ondernemende omgeving waarbij je zelf verantwoordelijkheid kan nemen. Ons aanbod De kans om een strategisch internationaal conversieproject te realiseren in een dynamische industriële omgeving. Een sleutelrol met zichtbaarheid op directieniveau. De mogelijkheid om na afloop van het project mee te werken aan nieuwe projecten binnen de SEA-invest groep. Een langetermijnperspectief binnen een solide en internationaal actieve organisatie.

review_candidates.title: Supervisor, Engineering Maintenance
review_candidates.description: About Newmont At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. About Lihir Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods. We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact. Purpose To provide mechanical engineering support for safe and efficient plant operations by delivering fit for purpose designs, driving reliability and delivering cost effective maintenance and improvement projects. Essential Duties Providing Mechanical Engineering support to the site’s production and maintenance teams. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve reliability, reduce downtime, and lower lifecycle costs. Undertake Mechanical design tasks from concepts through to execution. Delivering OPEX projects within budget and time constraints. This includes conducting engineering trials on assets to achieve extended life. Participating in CAPEX projects as part of a stakeholder. Monitor plant performance metrics and collate engineering reports. Analysing losses and conducting investigations using Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) standards. Assessing criticality of assets and developing, recommending, and implementing strategies for improving equipment reliability. Champion Change through Management of Change (MOC). Mentor and provide technical guidance to tradesmen, planners and junior/ graduate engineers. Working collaboratively with personnel across all business units. Training & Experience A bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, or related fields. Registered IEPNG member would be an advantage Project and Asset management Experience At least 5 years of experience in mining or related industry Knowledge of Fixed Plant systems including crushers, conveyors, grinding mills, flotation, tanks & tailings. Ability to provide mechanical engineering support to Fixed Plant Assets. Must have CMMS experience - preferably SAP. Have practical understanding of crushers, conveyors, grinding mills, flotation, tanks, and tailings systems. Effective organisation and planning skills High attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under less supervision Mechanically minded, self-motivated, result driven individual with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Working Conditions This role is offered on a 21/21 Fly in, Fly out (FIFO) roster from multiple locations in PNG to Lihir island. At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry. We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply we’d love to hear from you!

review_candidates.title: Senior Research Officer - MSNA - Global, Based in Amman
review_candidates.description: Jordan Senior Research Officer - MSNA - Global, Based in Amman Organization IMPACT Initiatives Posted 8 Sep 2026 Closing date 30 Sep 2026 BACKGROUND ON IMPACT & REACH REACH was born in 2010 as a joint initiative of two International NGOs (IMPACT Initiatives and ACTED) and the United Nations Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT). REACH’s purpose is to promote and facilitate the development of information products that enhance the humanitarian community’s decision making and planning capacity for emergency, reconstruction and development contexts. REACH facilitates information management for aid actors through three complementary services: (a) need and situation assessments facilitated by REACH teams; (b) situation analysis using satellite imagery; (c) provision of related database and (web)-mapping facilities and expertise. IMPACT Initiatives is a humanitarian NGO, based in Geneva, Switzerland. The organisation manages several initiatives, including the REACH Initiative. The IMPACT team comprises specialists in data collection, management and analysis and GIS. IMPACT was launched at the initiative of ACTED, an international NGO whose headquarter is based in Paris and is present in thirty countries. The two organizations have a strong complementarity formalized in a global partnership, enabling IMPACT to benefit from ACTED’s operational support on its fields of intervention. BACKGROUND ON MULTI-SECTOR NEEDS ASSESSMENT (MSNA) Over the past 10 years, REACH has established itself as a leader in the delivery of independent, crisis-wide Multi-Sectoral Needs Assessments (MSNAs). MSNAs respond directly to Grand Bargain commitments by providing impartial, unbiased, comprehensive, context-sensitive, and timely data to inform humanitarian decision-making. In doing so, MSNAs promote a shift in how humanitarian needs are measured and how response planning and prioritization decisions are made. MSNA data enables and promotes needs-based, evidence-based and people-centred decision making when it comes to aid. MSNAs are delivered on an annual cycle aligned with the Humanitarian Planning Cycle (HPC). IMPACT delivers approximately 20 MSNAs each year across some of the world’s most severe humanitarian crises. In 2026, IMPACT embarked on an exciting but ambitious journey to expand and improve the MSNA programme. The ultimate goal is to improve the resilience of the data and information system underpinning humanitarian aid policy by streamlining delivery of MSNAs, making them easier, faster and cost-effective the deliver by 2028. Delivering on this agenda requires a scale-up of the Global MSNA Team, close coordination with country teams delivering MSNAs, and with our Global Data Team (GDT) based in Amman. This position is therefore based in our Regional Office in Amman. We are currently looking for a Senior Research Officer (SRO) to join the Global MSNA Team of the Research Systems Unit (RSU). Title: Senior Research Officer – Research and Development (MSNA) Location: Amman, Jordan, with travel (up to 20% field deployment) Line management: Reports to the MSNA Research and Development (R&D) Specialist; administratively hosted by the IMPACT/ACTED office in Amman Contract duration: 12 months Start date: ASAP. POSITION PROFILE This position is situated within the Research Systems Unit (RSU) of the Global Programmes Section. Under the overall guidance of the Research Manager, the RSU supports the delivery of core, multi-sectoral research across IMPACT’s countries of operation. Reporting directly to the MSNA Research & Development (R&D) Specialist (based in Geneva), the Senior Research Officer (SRO) will lead and support various initiatives within the R&D workstream of the Global MSNA Team including, among others, MSNA toolkits and methods, the Multi-Sector Needs Index (MSNI), cross-crisis analysis, mortality & nutrition data modules, and digitalization of workflows.The position is based in Amman in order to keep methodological development close to the responses where MSNAs are implemented at the largest scale, to strengthen day-to-day technical support to country teams in the region and beyond, and to work closely with the Global Data Team (GDT) also based in Amman. Fucntion And Responsibilities The SRO will support the below core areas of work: MSNA toolkit and methods Lead the update of the MSNA sectoral indicator guidance, in coordination with sectoral specialists, and including making guidance notes fit for a public audience. Lead the development of the clean dataset template and the analysis tables template, taking account of the capacity of lower-resourced country teams. Contribute to the update of the MSNA Global Indicator Bank, the Data Analysis Plan (DAP) template, the KoBo template and checker, and the MSNA sampling guidance, including making relevant resources public. Support the coherence and interoperability of the toolkit across the research cycle, and its adaptation for external audiences and partner organisations. Fill in the gaps of the toolkit by developing additional resources, as needed. MSNA and cross-crisis analysis Develop a revamped Multi-Sector Needs Index (MSNI) guidance note, fit for external audiences, sharing it with other MSNA producers and supporting its uptake. Contribute to MSNI lessons learned from the 2026 cycle, any revisions to the framework, and support its presentation to external stakeholders. Support the production of cross-crisis analysis, including the consolidation and standardization of large country datasets and the processing of related documentation on data collection and sampling methods across countries. Contribute to global MSNA analysis products – quantitative analysis to identify key global trends and findings, and the production of short briefs, dashboards or other similar products for global audiences. Support external engagement with global stakeholders, donors and other REACH partners on MSNI and cross-crisis findings, including website articles, webinars and similar activities. Digitalization, automation and country support Work with the Data Specialist and the Global Data Team on reusable analysis pipelines, the consolidated R package environment (including “Humind”), and the specification of the MSNA Explorer. Contribute to the automation of repetitive MSNA workflows, including review support and KoBo checks. Provide technical support and guidance to REACH MSNA country teams at various stages of the research cycle, including research design and sampling methodologies; data collection planning; data processing, cleaning and management; quantitative data analysis; and the reporting and dissemination of inter-sectoral findings. Provide ad hoc surge support including country deployment up to 20% – remotely and/or through a field deployment, depending on the extent of support required and the specific needs of the country team. Contribute technical content to the Training and Certification Programme, in particular on indicator selection and analysis. Country support and quality assurance (approx. 30%) Act as primary focal point for several MSNA countries according to the MSNA team split per MSNA Cycle. This will involve: monthly check-ins, ad-hoc support throughout the full research cycle ensuring country teams have the resources needed to produce high-quality data and analysis, document reviews, reporting progress and challenges through the MSNA Info Tracker & HQ MSNA meetings, and proactively flagging issues to the wider MSNA team. Support in facilitation of the MSNA CoP and maintaining of the MSNA FAQ and intranet hub Review country outputs against the MSNA minimum requirements at each phase of the cycle – ToRs, DAPs, KoBo tools, clean datasets, analysis, MSNI frameworks and bulletins – in coordination with the research quality assurance and sectoral units. Key deliverables in the first 12 months Lead the revision and publication of key MSNA toolkit components, including sectoral guidance notes, technical templates and resources, ensuring coherence, usability, and accessibility for both REACH and external MSNA producers. Under the guidance of the R&D Specialist, prioritise and implement any methodological revisions to the MSNI Analytical framework, develop internal and external guidance & training materials to support the establishment and implementation of a standardized analytical framework and delivery of key metrics by country teams for the 2027 cycle. Support the R&D Specialist with the development, documentation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of a data pipeline that consolidates, harmonizes, validates, and processes MSNA datasets from multiple countries, enabling efficient comparative analysis, global reporting, including year-on-year trends analysis, and integration with the web-based MSNA Explorer. Advance the automation of key MSNA workflows, in particular the MSNI, and provide technical support to country teams throughout the research cycle, including research design, sampling, data management, analysis, and reporting, while contributing technical content to the MSNA Training and Certification Programme. Requirements Excellent academic qualifications, including Master's degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. development, humanitarian studies, international relations, research methods, social sciences, statistics). At least 2 years of experience in the humanitarian sector and/or field-based roles in fragile or development contexts. Experience with designing and implementing primary research, in particular large-scale quantitative surveys and/or humanitarian needs assessments. Solid understanding of statistical concepts and methods, including sampling. Advanced proficiency in R and/or Python for data processing, analysis and reproducible workflows is required for this position; familiarity with version control (Git) and with R package development is a strong asset. Experience developing, testing or otherwise working with multidimensional indices based on quantitative data to summarize multiple data points into easily digestible information an asset. Excellent communication and drafting skills for effective reporting, including the ability to explain methodological choices to non-technical audiences. Strong interpersonal skills, including good external engagement and coordination skills. Ability to operate in a cross-cultural environment requiring flexibility. Ability and willingness to engage in short term field deployments, including to complex and challenging security environments. Fluency in English required; proficiency in Arabic, French, or Spanish an asset. Familiarity with the humanitarian system and global humanitarian policy frameworks, in particular the Grand Bargain, the HPC and the JIAF. Experience with mortality and/or nutrition survey methods (e.g. SMART) an asset. Prior experience leading the design or implementation of MSNAs an asset. Familiarity with GIS principles and experience using GIS software an asset (e.g., ArcGIS, R, and/or QGIS). Ability to operate InDesign, a strong plus. Compensation & Benefits For this position, salary between 2’580 CHF and 2’640 CHF monthly (before income tax), etc as well as a monthly living allowance of 300 USD NB - IMPACT salaries are strictly determined by our salary grid depending on the grade of the position and the level of education of staff. A location-dependent security and/or isolation adjustment is then applied as a recognition that some staff are required to work in difficult places where living and working conditions are much more difficult than elsewhere. Accommodation and food provided in the guesthouse. Enrolment in Swiss private pension fund (Swisslife – approx. 9.975% of staff gross salary), health insurance, life insurance and repatriation assistance. Flight tickets every 6 months & visa fees covered (in-country travel costs and professional expenses are fully covered). Contribution to the luggage transportation: between 20 and 100 kgs, depending on the length of the contract (+ luggage and personal property insurance) Annual leave of 36 days per year. Public holidays of the country of assignment. Family/compassionate leave when applicable. Predeparture induction - 3 days at IMPACT Initiatives’s HQ in Geneva + one week pre-departure training in ACTED HQ in Paris, including a 4-days in situ security training; IMPACT prioritizes the psychological safety of its staff and the health insurance provided covers, among others, up to 1000 € per year of psychosocial counselling fees. How to apply Please apply directly on the website via the following link: Senior Research Officer – MSNA – Global, Based in Amman (Link For External Applicants) | Impact Job details Country Jordan Source IMPACT Initiatives Type Job Career category Information Management Years of experience 3-4 years Share Share this on Facebook Share this on X Post this on LinkedIn

review_candidates.description: Enterprise is a national nonprofit that exists to make a good home possible for the millions of families without one. We support community development organizations on the ground, aggregate and invest capital for impact, advance housing policy at every level of government, and build and manage communities ourselves. Since 1982, we have invested $92.0 billion and created 1.1 million homes across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands – all to make home and community places of pride, power and belonging. Join us at enterprisecommunity.org Working at Enterprise At Enterprise, you’ll be part of a diverse, committed team making a difference every day. You will collaborate with some of the smartest minds and biggest hearts in our field. You’ll be empowered to drive systems change and take bold steps to advance racial equity. And you will find a career home where you’re valued and supported in your growth journey. Enterprise offers career opportunities in our offices across the country with an exceptional benefits package. Job Description Summary The Senior Asset Manager, National Field Operations position will provide front line relationship management for a specified portfolio of LIHTC projects. The position is responsible for actively managing risks, analytical problem-solving, strategic engagement with the stakeholders of their portfolio of assets with a high degree of customer service, while gathering and sharing information from a diverse array of markets and programs. This position can be located remotely, but there is a preference for the Asset Manager to be in the Pacific, Mountain or Central time zones. Responsibilities Job Description Actively identify and prioritize issues through proactive involvement and problem solving by analyzing performance data, identifying issues and their root causes through in-depth financial analysis and leveraging stakeholder relationships. Facilitate inter-company communication between cross-functional teams and coordinate their expertise to champion issue resolution and customer requests, with a focus on adding value for both the Sponsor and Investor. Consolidate various departments’ centralized analysis to communicate an encompassing message to our stakeholders. Proactively interact with area Originators and Underwriters to gain insights into markets, partners, the LIHTC industry and how Asset Management can add value and share expertise between departments. Develop Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Realistic and Timely (SMART) plans to ensure issues and requests are proactively ushered towards resolution. Conduct partner meetings with stakeholders (largely GP’s and Sponsors) to: establish relationships with key players, better understand their organizational structure, identify primary business lines and their development pipeline, inquire about market influences and lessons learned, discuss regulatory policy changes, changes in sponsor policy and procedures, and shed light on any potential issues/concern. Conduct portfolio site visits to assess physical and compliance risks and make recommendations for improvement. Be a resource to provide thoughtful and informed recommendations based on experience, pulling in various teams/departments for participation when appropriate, and clearly understanding and articulating the benefit to the Partnership of recommendations. Qualifications Industry relevant undergraduate degree and/or CPM® Certification, HCCP Certification, or other industry recognized designations/certification/license. 5+ years of real estate operations / LIHTC or other relevant industry experience. A broad understanding of affordable housing and ability to understand the details of, and advise others in, Low Income Housing Tax Credit program regulations. Familiarity with various subsidy and grant. programs such as HOME, Section 8, SRO, NAHASDA, HOPWA, VA and Continuum of Care. Strong real estate financial and analytical skills, including underwriting/deal structure, comparative analysis, audit review and identification of underlying performance issues. The ability to lead groups of diverse stakeholders (GP/PM/legal counsel/state agencies, investors) through project level discussions. Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated ability to work through complex issues, not only understanding our goals, but also acknowledging the goals of the person with whom we are negotiating, determining their motive(s) and minimum needs, and negotiating for a win-win outcome. Ability to work independently and multi-task with competing deadlines during peak reporting times. Possess critical thinking skills, offering opinions and a decisive course of action based on analysis of the fact set, drawing on internal staff across the department and/or business lines to support final recommendation. Incumbent is expected to demonstrate strong ethics in interpersonal relations and work as an effective, collaborative team member across Asset Management and Enterprise. Seeks opportunities to improve current systems/processes/tools, understanding that innovation is valued in our culture. Able to travel to and throughout multiple Enterprise properties.' Able to walk properties in inclement weather. Salary Transparency You will be joining a team of talented professionals motivated by serving the community and addressing the need for affordable housing. Enterprise offers a comprehensive total rewards package for you and your family. The pay range for this position is $105,000 - $128,000 . The salary range represents the low and high end of what may be paid for this position. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range, and compensation decisions may be influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Total Rewards at Enterprise This range is just one component of our total rewards package, which also includes annual performance bonuses and generous paid leave programs. Our benefits form a major part of the total rewards package. These include dental, health, and vision care plans, as well as family-building benefits such as adoption and surrogacy support. Enterprise supports flexible work arrangements to promote work-life balance and offers health advocacy, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and mental health benefits. We round out our package with financial education, wellness programs, and auto-enrollment in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions. Finally, you will have access to learning and development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement for job-related courses and certifications. Thank you for your interest in joining the Enterprise team and contributing to our mission to serve others. #ID

review_candidates.title: Regional Director- Africa
review_candidates.description: ABOUT ISRAAID IsraAID is an international humanitarian NGO headquartered in Israel. Founded in 2001, our teams have worked in emergency and long-term development settings in 60+ countries, mobilizing quickly to help communities affected by crises — from hurricanes to refugee crises to pandemics — rebuild toward self-reliance. IsraAID has operated in Africa since 2011. The Africa Regional Desk oversees Country Offices in Kenya, Malawi, Uganda, and South Sudan, with programming grounded in a community resilience framework. ABOUT THE POSITION The Director of Africa Region is the primary regional authority for IsraAID's Africa portfolio, holding full line management responsibility for Country Directors across the region. Working closely with the Senior Director RRP and Senior Management Team, the Director leads the regional desk team (including the SPO, Africa Region), drives Country Office performance, and serves as the key management interface between HQ departments and Country Directors in Malawi, Uganda, Kenya, and South Sudan — leading the regional team through a matrix structure while ensuring operational needs on the ground are fully supported. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Line Management & People Leadership Hold formal line management of all Africa CDs and the Africa SPO — setting objectives, performance expectations, and conducting reviews Mentor and coach CDs, building leadership capacity and addressing leadership gaps/transitions Lead and coordinate the regional desk team under the matrix structure Represent country realities in HQ strategic conversations and represent the region externally Country Office Performance, Risk & Stabilization Own overall performance, stability, and risk profile of all Africa COs Identify operational, financial, reputational, and contextual risks early; oversee stabilization/performance-improvement plans Provide decisive leadership during crises, transitions, or CO instability Strategic Execution & Programme Quality Guide country strategies and workplans in line with global strategy and the resilience framework Ensure programmatic quality standards across the portfolio, partnering with the Technical Unit Integrate resilience, sustainability, MEAL, safeguarding, and inclusion into programme design Ensure learning and evidence inform decisions at CO, regional, and HQ levels HQ Coordination & Regional Team Management Lead the Africa regional team, ensuring coherent, prioritized HQ support to COs Coordinate HQ technical/operational/enabling functions for consistent guidance Prevent CO overload by prioritizing HQ requests and escalating competing demands Support and empower the SPO, Africa Region Partnerships, Fundraising & Local Donor Engagement Support CDs in cultivating partnerships and donor relationships, in coordination with DevComs Maintain institutional relationships with regional/country partners, ensuring continuity Lead regional donor positioning and identify strategic funding opportunities with the Senior Director RRP and DevComs Safeguarding & Organizational Values Champion safeguarding standards across the Africa portfolio Ensure CDs and regional team are trained to identify, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns Act as a senior representative for accountability, ethics, and IsraAID's values: Professionalism, Humanity, Collaboration, Flexibility, Adaptability ESSENTIAL SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES Education Master's degree in International Development, Project Management, Social Sciences, Humanitarian Affairs, or related field. Experience 10+ years of progressive leadership/management in humanitarian/development settings internationally, including 5+ years in sub-Saharan Africa (required) Proven direct line management of Country Directors or equivalent senior managers across multiple contexts Experience in CO oversight, risk management, and performance management in fragile/complex environments Programme quality oversight across Education, Health & Nutrition, Protection, WASH; strong grasp of results-based management and resilience approaches Financial management of significant multi-country budgets Donor engagement and resource mobilization with institutional donors (UN agencies, foundations, bilateral donors) Experience managing matrix structures and multi-disciplinary HQ support teams Leadership & Management Exceptional people leadership; able to hold accountability while coaching and developing others Strong crisis management and stabilization skills; decisive under pressure and ambiguity Ability to align diverse, multi-stakeholder teams toward common goals High independence, initiative, and sound judgment Strong organizational skills managing competing priorities and deadlines Technical & Programme Skills Deep understanding of programme design, implementation, M&E, and learning in humanitarian/resilience contexts Familiarity with IASC guidelines and international humanitarian coordination structures Strong analytical and strategic planning skills Understanding of safeguarding and ethical/compliance frameworks Interpersonal & Communication Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills; ability to influence and coach across roles/levels Demonstrated cultural competency across diverse contexts and organizational cultures Commitment to IsraAID's values IT & Languages Proficient in Microsoft Office and collaboration platforms (Teams, Zoom) Fluent English required; French or other regional languages an advantage Able to travel to Africa Country Offices and HQ on short notice ETHICAL STANDARDS IsraAID has zero tolerance for misconduct and Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA). Recruitment includes candidate declarations and reference checks focused on misconduct and SEA. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES IsraAID is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status..

review_candidates.title: Project Director - Railway
review_candidates.description: Our client is one of Saudi Arabia's established and highly experienced construction and infrastructure groups, with a track record spanning more than four decades across civil construction, infrastructure, roads, bridges, railways, water, energy, buildings and specialist industrial projects . The Group has delivered an extensive portfolio of major infrastructure developments across Saudi Arabia and the wider region. Its current portfolio represents more than SAR 50 billion in project value , encompassing major national infrastructure and development programmes with a proven track record of successfully delivered rail infrastructure projects with KSA. The Role: We are seeking an established Project Director with a substantial track record of delivering major railway, transportation or infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will take overall leadership responsibility for the delivery of a multi-billion SAR railway infrastructure project , based on site in Western Saudi. You will provide strategic and operational leadership across the full project lifecycle, working with senior client representatives, consultants, JV/consortium partners, specialist contractors and internal project teams. The project will encompass the delivery of major railway and associated civil infrastructure, including track, stations, depots, earthworks, structures, roads, utilities, drainage, MEP, landscaping and interfaces with specialist railway systems. Key Responsibilities Provide overall leadership and direction for the project and establish a clear delivery strategy. Take full accountability for project performance across programme, cost, quality, HSE and delivery . Lead project mobilisation and establish the project organisation, governance and delivery structure. Manage large multidisciplinary teams across construction, engineering, commercial, planning, procurement, HSE and QA/QC. Oversee the delivery of major civil, structural, railway and associated infrastructure works. Ensure effective coordination between design, construction, railway infrastructure and specialist systems interfaces. Establish and maintain robust project programmes and ensure critical milestones are achieved. Lead commercial performance, cost management, variations, claims and contractual obligations. Manage major subcontractors, suppliers, consultants and project partners. Develop effective relationships with the client, authorities, consultants and other key stakeholders. Identify and proactively manage project risks, opportunities and critical delivery issues. Maintain the highest standards of HSE, quality and environmental performance. Ensure compliance with Saudi regulations, project specifications and contractual requirements. Provide regular reporting and strategic recommendations to senior management. Lead the project through construction, testing, commissioning and handover as required. Candidate Profile: Essential Requirements 20+ years' professional experience within major infrastructure, construction, transportation or railway projects. Proven experience leading large-scale, multi-billion SAR/USD projects or programmes . Strong GCC experience, with significant Saudi Arabia experience highly preferred . Demonstrable experience operating at Project Director level with overall responsibility for major project delivery. Strong civil infrastructure and construction background. Experience managing complex multidisciplinary teams and major project interfaces. Strong commercial and contractual understanding. Experience working within major contractor, JV or consortium environments. Strong understanding of project controls, programme management, risk, HSE and QA/QC. Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills. Experience with major Saudi clients, government entities, consultants and international JV partners would be highly advantageous. Education Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction, Railway Engineering, Infrastructure or a related discipline . Master's degree and/or recognised project management qualification advantageous. Professional accreditation such as Chartered Engineer, PMP or equivalent would be beneficial.

Demonstrated ability to manage senior-level stakeholders and deliver multiple workstreams within complex project environments. review_candidates.title: Product Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: About Us Spiro is Africa’s largest EV player, accelerating the continent’s shift to electric mobility. We’ve grown 5× in the last year and are targeting a 100× scale. With four manufacturing facilities and 1,000+ retail outlets across 10 countries, we pair industrial scale with pan-Africa reach. The role Be the vital bridge between Spiro’s field operations and the mobility product team. Launch every release into live operations across our seven markets, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Benin, Togo, Nigeria and Cameroon, make ground teams successful with it, and carry evidencebacked feedback and priorities back to product and tech. Embedded in the market, you ensure what is shipped becomes what is used. The role reports directly to the CEO and is field-based, with 50-70% of your time spent in market. Key Responsibilties Feature Adoption & Enablement In-market launches across lead and dealer management, sales, delivery, warehouse and manufacturing tools; training and local champions in every market; adoption driven until each feature becomes the default way of working. Feedback Loop Structured product feedback from ground teams covering usability, local nuances and market-specific needs, triaged and prioritised into clear, actionable insights that product and tech can move on quickly. Prioritisation with the PCH A live partnership with the Product Country Head and central product team on what each market needs next, backed by usage data and field insight, and voiced in roadmap calls. Adoption Measurement Adoption and usage metrics for every release; regular scorecards and quantified on-ground impact so wins are visible and scalable. Field Intelligence Market intelligence flowing into product thinking: competitive moves, dealer and customer behaviour shifts, and emerging needs that shape the roadmap early. Cross-Market Alignment Adoption playbooks and learnings carried across all seven markets and extended to each new one as we expand, so every rollout benefits from what has already worked. We are looking for - 3-5 years of experience in product operations, technology-enabled field operations or operations strategy within a high-growth environment. A proven track record at the intersection of business operations and technical product development, with hands-on use of CRMs, dashboards and workflow tools. The ability to learn new systems quickly and articulate them simply; comfortable discussing APIs and data flows with engineers, and querying data using SQL. Credibility with both field stakeholders and product teams, supported by precise written communication across requirements, insights and performance reporting. A genuine affinity for field work across dealerships, warehouses and delivery operations, with a willingness to travel regularly across markets. Professional fluency in English, with French and/or Swahili considered a strong advantage. Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline. Interested candidates with relevant experience and open to explore global opportunitites, please submit your resume for consideration.
